answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, the Raven protocol binds identity generation to dynamic opportunity-cost staking collateral paired with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function. This structure renders any malicious multiplication an economic fable, as subgame-perfect slashing matrices impose penalties exceeding any potential collusion payoff. Consequently, as the tide of malicious agents increases, the expected attack utility becomes strictly negative, converging to a unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
